name: Telangana Police Recruitment (SI, ASI and Constable)

organization.name: Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board

department: Telangana Police, Special Protection Force, Fire and Disaster Response, Prisons and Correctional Services
summary: Telangana's police recruitment for Stipendiary Cadet Trainee Sub-Inspectors, Police Constables and equivalent posts. The 2026 drive has 7,437 vacancies across four notifications. Written tests, physical tests and a final exam.

status.note: Four notifications issued on 29 July 2026 (7,437 posts). Online applications from 19 August 2026; deadline extended to 16 September 2026. Test dates to be announced by the Board.

posts.name: SCT Sub-Inspector (Civil) and equivalent posts
posts.responsibilities: Station house and investigation duties; equivalent posts in SPF, Fire and Prisons.
posts.notes: 275 posts. Starting annual salary incl. HRA about Rs 7,33,990 to 7,99,980 (Police/SPF) or Rs 6,74,820 to 7,35,490 (equivalent posts elsewhere), as stated by the Board.

posts.name: SCT Assistant Sub-Inspector, Finger Print Bureau
posts.notes: 23 posts. Starting annual salary incl. HRA about Rs 5,85,640 to 6,38,280.

posts.name: SCT Police Constable (Civil) and equivalent posts
posts.responsibilities: Police station, armed reserve and equivalent duties.
posts.notes: 7,112 posts. Starting annual salary incl. HRA about Rs 4,21,310 to 4,59,180.

age.summary: Age limits are set in each notification (not reproduced here).

eligibility.domicile: Local cadre rules with local reservation.

education.summary: Constable: Intermediate (Class 12). SI: a bachelor's degree. Technical posts need specific qualifications.

eligibility.physical: Physical measurement and efficiency tests as per notification.
eligibility.reservation: Telangana reservation rules. In 2026 the SC Group I, II and III sub-classification is applied in police recruitment for the first time, and women get 33.3% reservation in all SPF and Fire Services posts.

eligibilityRules.notes: Upper age limit is in each notification. SI posts need a degree.

selection.meritCalculation: Merit from the final written exam among candidates clearing the qualifying stages.
selection.documentVerification: Aadhaar verification is used from the 2026 cycle.
selection.probation: Stipendiary training; regular pay after training.

sections.subject: Typical areas
topics: General studies including Telangana history and movement

statistics.note: Interim count on 8 Sep 2026: 2,76,085 candidates had submitted applications (3,80,762 candidatures) while applications were still open.

salary.officialGrossNote: The Board states a starting annual salary including HRA of about Rs 4,21,310 for constables (about Rs 35,109 a month) and about Rs 7,33,990 for SIs (about Rs 61,166 a month).
salary.notes: Risk allowance up to 50 to 60% of salary in high-risk units, family medical treatment and welfare loans, as stated by the Board.

benefits.detail: Up to 50 to 60% of salary in high-risk units.
Medical treatment for employee and family; loans for house building, children's education and marriage.

workLife.hazards: Moderate to high in special units.

difficulty.rationale: Over 2.7 lakh applicants by 8 Sep 2026 for 7,437 posts; physical tests eliminate many.

sources.title: TGPRB press note on Police Recruitment 2026 (Rc Nos. 189, 225, 234 and 279/2026), 8 Sep 2026
sources.publisher: Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board

gaps: Notification texts not read: age limits, PET standards and exam pattern not reproduced.
dataQuality.notes: Vacancies, dates and pay from the official press note.
